questions.question: In a vision of heaven standing open, the rider on the white horse is called Faithful and True. He judges and wages war with what?
In a vision of the rider on the white horse, what name is written on His robe and on His thigh?

answers.text: KING OF KINGS AND LORD OF LORDS
HOLY HOLY HOLY LORD GOD ALMIGHTY
MIGHTY GOD AND PRINCE OF PEACE

questions.question: In a vision of the end, the beast and the kings of the earth gather their armies to make war against whom?

answers.text: The rider on the white horse and His army
The angel standing in the sun

questions.question: In a vision of the rider on the white horse, the beast who went to war against Him was captured. True or false?
